title: qa.request
comment: control-plane: unversioned by design (ROADMAP §3.7). Carries the *raw* user QA payload that the Go gateway escalated to `sec.input.v1` for classifier-tier review. Mutually exclusive with the gateway's direct `qa.request.v1` `pass` path.
description: Phase 7 §7.1: raw QA payload escalated by the gateway to sec.input.v1. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::QaRequest`.

raw_text.description: Raw, post-deterministic-rules-but-pre-classifier user text. Length already capped at `cfg.sec_input_max_len` bytes by the gateway.

ip.description: Subject IP / CIDR prefix per §7.3 IPv6 prefix bucketing.

client_id.description: Post-auth subject id, when JWT was present.
